hardRules: Never invoke image generation because a screen looks visually incomplete.

A whole-page or whole-screen render is never a valid source asset. If a generated result contains navigation, page title, buttons, wheel, live state text or other product UI, classify it CONCEPT_ONLY / REJECTED_AS_IMPLEMENTATION.

Only one generated asset candidate may be active at a time. Before another generation call, the active candidate must be integrated into the real proposal, browser-rendered and either accepted, retained as candidate, or rejected.
The browser render is the owner-review surface. Generated source images are implementation inputs, not proof of progress.
References may guide design language but are not automatic generation triggers.
League logos/marks should be deterministic SVG/component work when practical; do not generate whole logo-sheet screenshots as final runtime assets.
Production logic, Firebase, saves, shared-session behavior and routing remain untouched by image generation.
